title: PowerToys Run: "Open Containing Folder" not selecting/highlighting program

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix confirms this exact selection behavior is resolved. Direct repro supports a concrete hypothesis, but current behavior must be tested.

proposed_fixes.title: Pass the selected program path to Explorer for Go-to-location
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Go-to-location opens only the containing directory, without asking Explorer to select the executable, so the folder appears at its default scroll position.
plan: Reproduce on current build with a program executable deep in its containing folder and inspect launch target/arguments.
If the command launches only the directory, pass the resolved executable through Explorer's supported /select argument with correct quoting.
Add focused coverage for paths containing spaces and ensure the selected target is the executable, not a shortcut or parent directory.
verification: Invoke Ctrl+Shift+E and the sub-icon; Explorer should open the correct folder with the executable selected.
Repeat with a path containing spaces and a non-file target to ensure normal folder opening remains intact.

confidence.rationale: The repro and Explorer mechanism are explicit, but current code and behavior have not been checked.
